name: Small Talk & Zombies
source:
Which sounds worse: Getting your brain eaten or engaging in small talk?

Patrick is going to have to figure that out real quick. He wakes up in a world filled with zombies roaming the streets for brains and content, but deduces that there might be a way to bring people back. But does the end justify the means? Maybe getting your brain eaten isn't so bad...

[From [url=https://gary-the-enchanter.itch.io/small-talk-zombies]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
哪件事听起来更糟：脑子被吃掉，还是和人寒暄？

Patrick得赶快弄明白这个问题。他醒来后发现，世界满是游荡街头、寻找脑子与网络内容的丧尸，却推测也许有办法让人们恢复原状。但目的能让手段变得合理吗？也许脑子被吃掉，也没那么糟……
